manual:
Lists the dashboard's own core scripts - the dashboard itself, its Integration Service Supervisor, and any other always-present framework piece - rather than any single automation. Each one gets its own panel here with live status, RAM, and lifecycle controls.

Before it starts managed services, Service Supervisor publishes one shared API-capability snapshot for their lightweight launchers. A missing, incomplete, or stale snapshot makes those dependent launcher features wait instead of assuming access. This is also where you'd restart the supervisor directly, or check whether a core piece of the framework itself is currently running - separate from any individual automation service, which lives under its own menu entry instead.
